points.title: 王子成长
points.description: 亨利八世出生于伦敦格林尼治宫，是亨利七世和约克的伊丽莎白的次子。作为次子，他原本不被期望继承王位，接受了当时王子应有的教育，包括拉丁语、法语、意大利语等多种语言的学习，以及骑术、狩猎、剑术等骑士技能的训练。这一时期，他的兄长亚瑟王子早逝，使他意外成为王位继承人。这段经历塑造了他对荣誉、权力和军事成就的强烈追求，为他后来的统治风格奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Henry VIII was born at Greenwich Palace in London as the second son of Henry VII and Elizabeth of York. As the second son, he was not originally expected to inherit the throne, receiving the education typical of a prince, including multiple languages (Latin, French, Italian) and knightly skills (riding, hunting, fencing). When his elder brother Arthur died unexpectedly, Henry became heir to the throne. This formative period shaped his strong pursuit of honor, power, and military achievements, laying the foundation for his later reign style.

points.title: 早期统治
points.description: 1509年，18岁的亨利八世继承王位，开始了他在威斯敏斯特宫的统治。初期，他受托马斯·沃尔西红衣主教影响，推行外交政策，参与意大利战争，并在1513年取得军事胜利。这一时期，他致力于提升英格兰的国际地位，与法国和神圣罗马帝国保持平衡关系。1515年，他任命沃尔西为大法官，推动宗教改革前的教会改革。亨利八世此时以文艺复兴君主形象示人，热爱艺术、音乐和建筑，修建了汉普顿宫等宏伟建筑，并成为英国皇家海军的奠基人之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1509, 18-year-old Henry VIII ascended to the throne and began his reign at Westminster Palace. Initially influenced by Cardinal Thomas Wolsey, he pursued foreign policy, participated in the Italian Wars, and achieved military victories in 1513. During this period, he worked to elevate England's international position, maintaining balanced relations with France and the Holy Roman Empire. In 1515, he appointed Wolsey as Lord Chancellor, promoting church reforms before the English Reformation. Henry presented himself as a Renaissance monarch, passionate about arts, music, and architecture, building magnificent structures like Hampton Palace and becoming one of the founders of the Royal Navy.

points.title: 离婚危机
points.description: 1527年，亨利八世陷入离婚危机，他希望与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳离婚以迎娶安妮·博林。这一事件成为他统治的转折点，促使他与罗马教廷决裂。亨利八世坚持其婚姻无效，认为凯瑟琳是其兄长的遗孀，违反了《利未记》中的禁忌。尽管沃尔西多次尝试在罗马寻求离婚许可，但教皇克莱门特七世受凯瑟琳外甥神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世的影响，拒绝批准。这一危机导致亨利八世逐渐失去对教廷的信任，开始寻求国内解决方案，最终导致英国宗教改革。
points.descriptionEn: In 1527, Henry VIII faced a divorce crisis, seeking to annul his marriage to Catherine of Aragon to marry Anne Boleyn. This event marked a turning point in his reign, leading to his break with the Roman Catholic Church. Henry insisted his marriage was invalid, citing Catherine's status as his brother's widow, which violated the prohibition in Leviticus. Despite Wolsey's attempts to secure papal approval in Rome, Pope Clement VII, influenced by Catherine's nephew Emperor Charles V, refused to grant the annulment. This crisis led Henry to lose trust in the papacy and seek domestic solutions, ultimately resulting in the English Reformation.

points.title: 宗教改革
points.description: 1533年，亨利八世与安妮·博林秘密结婚，并任命托马斯·克伦威尔为首席大臣。1534年，通过《至尊法案》，亨利八世成为英格兰教会最高领袖，确立了英国国教。这一改革使英格兰教会脱离罗马教廷，但保留了天主教的大部分教义和仪式。亨利八世解散了修道院，没收其财产，这一行动不仅改变了宗教格局，也极大地增加了王室财富。在此期间，他处决了反对改革的托马斯·莫尔和约翰·费希尔等宗教领袖。1536年，安妮·博林被处决后，亨利八世又与简·西摩结婚，后者为他生下了继承人爱德华。
points.descriptionEn: In 1533, Henry VIII secretly married Anne Boleyn and appointed Thomas Cromwell as chief minister. In 1534, through the Act of Supremacy, Henry declared himself the Supreme Head of the Church of England, establishing the Anglican Church. This reform separated the English Church from Rome while retaining most Catholic doctrines and rituals. Henry dissolved the monasteries and confiscated their wealth, which not only changed the religious landscape but significantly increased royal fortune. During this period, he executed religious opponents like Thomas More and John Fisher. After Anne Boleyn's execution in 1536, Henry married Jane Seymour, who gave him the heir Edward.

points.title: 婚姻动荡
points.description: 1540年是亨利八世婚姻最为动荡的一年，他先后与克利夫斯的安妮结婚并迅速离婚，随后处决了托马斯·克伦威尔。同年，他又与凯瑟琳·霍华德结婚，但这位年轻的新娘在1542年被指控不忠并被处决。这一时期，亨利八世的健康状况开始恶化，腿部伤口长期不愈，体重急剧增加，脾气也变得更加暴躁。尽管如此，他仍然继续推行国家政策，包括与法国和苏格兰的战争，以及加强海军力量。1543年，他与凯瑟琳·帕尔结婚，这是他最后一位妻子，也是唯一一位在他死后幸存的妻子。
points.descriptionEn: 1540 was the most turbulent year in Henry VIII's marital life. He married Anne of Cleves, quickly divorced her, and then executed Thomas Cromwell. Later that year, he married Catherine Howard, who was accused of infidelity and executed in 1542. During this period, Henry's health began to decline; his leg wound never healed, his weight increased dramatically, and his temper grew more volatile. Despite this, he continued to pursue state policies, including wars with France and Scotland, and strengthened naval power. In 1543, he married Catherine Parr, his last wife and the only one who survived him.

points.title: 晚年统治
points.description: 1545年至1547年，亨利八世在里士满宫度过晚年，健康状况持续恶化。尽管身体虚弱，他仍然关注国家事务，包括与苏格兰的战争和与法国的和平谈判。1546年，他签署了《六条信仰法案》，进一步确立了英国国教的基本教义。亨利八世晚年对宗教态度变得更为保守，对新教徒和天主教徒都采取强硬立场。他开始准备王位继承事宜，确立其子爱德华为继承人，同时确保女儿玛丽和伊丽莎布斯的继承权。1547年1月28日，亨利八世在里士满宫去世，享年55岁，葬于温莎城堡圣乔治礼拜堂。
points.descriptionEn: From 1545 to 1547, Henry VIII spent his later years at Richmond Palace, with his health continuing to decline. Despite his physical weakness, he remained engaged in state affairs, including wars with Scotland and peace negotiations with France. In 1546, he signed the Six Articles, further establishing the doctrines of the Church of England. In his later years, Henry's religious stance became more conservative, taking a hard line against both Protestants and Catholics. He prepared for the succession, establishing his son Edward as heir while ensuring the rights of his daughters Mary and Elizabeth. On January 28, 1547, Henry VIII died at Richmond Palace at age 55, buried in St. George's Chapel at Windsor Castle.

supporter.zh: 亨利八世被视为一位强有力的君主，他巩固了英格兰的王权，建立了独立的英国国教，使英格兰摆脱了罗马教廷的控制。他加强海军力量，为日后英国成为海上霸主奠定基础。他支持文艺复兴，促进了艺术和建筑的发展，使英国宫廷成为欧洲文化中心之一。亨利八世的统治时期见证了英格兰民族意识的觉醒，他通过一系列政治和宗教改革，强化了国家主权和民族认同。
supporter.en: Henry VIII is viewed as a strong monarch who consolidated royal power in England, established the independent Church of England, and freed the nation from papal control. He strengthened the navy, laying the foundation for Britain's future maritime dominance. A patron of the Renaissance, he promoted arts and architecture, making the English court a European cultural center. His reign witnessed the awakening of English national identity, and through political and religious reforms, he strengthened national sovereignty and national cohesion.

critic.zh: 批评者认为亨利八世是一位残暴专制的君主，他处决了包括两位妻子在内的多人，对宗教改革持实用主义态度而非真正信仰。他解散修道院主要是出于贪婪而非宗教原则，导致大量文化遗产被破坏。亨利八世的婚姻政策混乱，不仅造成个人悲剧，也引发政治动荡。他的财政挥霍和对战争的偏好使国库空虚，给国家带来沉重负担。此外，他晚年变得偏执多疑，统治风格日益专制，背离了早期的人文主义理想。
critic.en: Critics view Henry VIII as a tyrannical monarch who executed numerous people including two of his wives, and approached the Reformation with pragmatism rather than genuine faith. His dissolution of monasteries was driven more by greed than religious principles, resulting in the destruction of cultural heritage. His chaotic marital policies caused personal tragedies and political instability. His financial extravagance and preference for warfare depleted the treasury, imposing heavy burdens on the nation. Additionally, he became increasingly paranoid and autocratic in his later years, abandoning his early humanistic ideals.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，亨利八世被定义为一位复杂矛盾的历史人物，既是文艺复兴式的君主，又是宗教改革的推动者。他的六次婚姻和处决两位妻子的经历使他成为历史上最具争议的君主之一。现代历史研究强调亨利八世统治的多面性，既承认他强化国家主权的成就，也不回避其专制和残暴的一面。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为肥胖、专横的形象，但同时也被视为塑造现代英国的关键人物。他的统治标志着中世纪向近代的过渡，对英国政治、宗教和文化产生了深远影响。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Henry VIII is defined as a complex and contradictory figure—both a Renaissance monarch and a driving force behind the Reformation. His six marriages and execution of two wives make him one of history's most controversial rulers. Modern historical research emphasizes the multifaceted nature of his reign, acknowledging his achievements in strengthening national sovereignty while not overlooking his autocratic and brutal aspects. In popular culture, he is often depicted as obese and tyrannical, but also recognized as a key figure in shaping modern Britain. His reign marked the transition from medieval to early modern times and had profound impacts on British politics, religion, and culture.

self.zh: 朕乃国王，且朕应为国王。
self.en: I am the king, and I should be king.

others.zh: 他是一位伟大而可怕的君主，其统治时期对英格兰历史产生了深远影响。
others.en: He was a great and terrible king whose reign had a profound impact on English history.
